name: Smash the City
desc:
💥 Smash the City 💥
Pick a weapon, aim at the skyline and watch the whole city come crashing down, floor by floor!

USE CODE "SMASH" for 5,000 COINS!

🚀 50+ WEAPONS in 7 categories: missiles, nukes, tornadoes, tsunamis, meteors, black holes, orbital lasers, a giant ape, a sand worm, UFOs, a wrecking ball, Tetris blocks and more
🎚️ Crank the sliders: bigger blasts, more missiles, longer storms
🗺️ 11 MAPS: Downtown, Night City, a suspension bridge, a power plant, a football stadium, Tokyo, the pyramids of Giza, a base on the Moon and more
☢️ Crack the reactor and watch the radiation eat the city
🪙 Earn coins for every block you break, plus bonuses at 25%, 50%, 75% and 95% destroyed
🔓 Unlock bigger weapons and new maps as you go
👥 Team up with friends and wreck the same city together

How much of the skyline can you smash? 🏙️
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new weapons and maps!
